prompt: Which tool is designed to grip and turn round pipe and fittings?

rationales.message: An adjustable wrench turns nuts and bolts with smooth jaws; it is not the purpose-built choice for round pipe.
A combination wrench matches nuts and bolts rather than gripping round pipe.
Correct. A pipe wrench has serrated jaws designed to grip and turn round pipe and fittings.
Slip-joint pliers can grip varied objects within their limits, but the pipe wrench is the tool designed for this task.
